draft.title: Taccuino del giorno · 2 agosto 2026
draft.excerpt: Cinque giovani talenti azzurri tra conferme e ambizioni: dal Napoli che blinda Marianucci all'Inter che respinge offerte per Iddrissou, fino a Lipani che sogna la Nazionale con il Sassuolo.
draft.excerptEn: Five young Italian talents between confirmations and ambitions: from Napoli securing Marianucci to Inter rejecting offers for Iddrissou, up to Lipani dreaming of the National team with Sassuolo.
draft.bodyIt:
**Luca Marianucci** Il Napoli toglie dal mercato il centrocampista azzurrino, blindando un prospetto su cui ripone fiducia per il progetto futuro. Una scelta che testimonia la volontà partenopea di costruire dal vivaio in vista dei grandi obiettivi. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxPc1pDd1BEWUlHY2RzRFNHVWF4aTBlSlpzNkdQc1czVnZ1MUQ1RUJhak5nT0twOF9iemM4bWE2VGNTWTVZb3dNUzNEMFJaMU9jOXo0NnQ5T3VUb2QwWS1YMmc3V01HVWNtczBFT2dzWi1GMW9wOGdyZnFSZTFQdkc1blB3M2tRT1U?oc=5)

**Jamal Iddrissou** L'Inter U23 respinge la proposta del Colonia e mantiene la calma nel mercato: il giovane talento resta blindato in nerazzurro. Un segnale chiaro della società sulla volontà di trattenere prospetti su cui crede per il futuro europeo. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxOcy1ERGQxZVppTWJ6ZDUxTWxlQkFxVEltaEotLVFtakswckYwcHFkOU5icl95SnA1TFczQTRVTUxZSC1GMUxtaXNjSDVHeEJtekZyQXVSMElnN2lsaG9xWVk3SnNSS1g2MzcxLW5iWTFyNG5jZDdYVXRQS3BSVzlWZ0JzTVAzR0VhX0lMYU9ueU9zY1JlMlNrc2Y1NmxRcndsVzNvaA?oc=5)

**Luca Lipani** Il centrocampista del Sassuolo ripone la massima fiducia nel tecnico Aquilani come maestro di calcio. Con l'impegno giusto, la Nazionale arriverà naturalmente: una mentalità da vero futuribile con gli occhi su Qatar 2030. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxQMHVOaVIyZEtUc294b3YzTUVuU2F4c3ZNcEgxeWFNUVJIZHNNWHB2MXdqOTdMbWlnRUdva2R2R1VMVW1sYmlvbkcyV0JpdDRvM2hkZ2ZPYTZQR1Q4UGxyMzVVVzVPS0xQTGN5Z2pXSUNHcFYwajNfTHJCQXhBQS0zVmFMaG16aktBMmdINzMxcTdMRjM0MHVRTkx6ZVZ5ZExXZ05KRHJR?oc=5)

**Giovanni Fabbian** La Lazio segue il centrocampista nel mercato, anche se Gattuso sembra orientato verso un profilo diverso. Un'ulteriore conferma dell'interesse dei grandi club verso i giovani talenti della Next Gen italiana. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxPd1hWaGkzaGtiTUZsYWVuMmdROHhGcmctekNaX1NvZ2FLREowaEZJeUk3bEJSTnd3MmpPT1BuVDd2TEEycElabk1teVNySlhZSjgxUzZIQVMxWTRqVjZqMk5hdjNQTW80Sm5RRnZhal9uNG1VcUJqLU1Janl1VGtVNkRoQXliN2M3ZkxiejY5NVlEaVNzZHVNaTNwWTdLRnRFbmc?oc=5)

**Mattia Marello** Il centrocampista continua a essere monitorate dai principali club di Serie A nel tormentato panorama del calciomercato estivo. Un prospetto su cui la Serie A ripone speranze concrete in vista dei prossimi anni. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMic0FVX3lxTE5TWGpTV3NrYXF1bEtMZm5ZZThINmlCeW52M3htRlpKS2tST3p3dTc2alNsX2ZlM1hoVldvSWNjZ3Y5NHFtRDExcE8yMXNHTjYtakU2YU1MbS1LeUQxVjY1YWlubUp6Sm9RQWd6cmRUaUVYcVU?oc=5)

**Luca Marianucci** Napoli removes the young midfielder from the market, securing a prospect they believe in for their future project. A choice that shows the Partenopeans' desire to build from their academy system ahead of major objectives. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxPc1pDd1BEWUlHY2RzRFNHVWF4aTBlSlpzNkdQc1czVnZ1MUQ1RUJhak5nT0twOF9iemM4bWE2VGNTWTVZb3dNUzNEMFJaMU9jOXo0NnQ5T3VUb2QwWS1YMmc3V01HVWNtczBFT2dzWi1GMW9wOGdyZnFSZTFQdkc1blB3M2tRT1U?oc=5)

**Jamal Iddrissou** Inter U23 rejects Cologne's proposal and holds firm in the market: the young talent remains locked in the Nerazzurri colours. A clear signal from the club about their intention to retain prospects they believe in for the European future. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxOcy1ERGQxZVppTWJ6ZDUxTWxlQkFxVEltaEotLVFtakswckYwcHFkOU5icl95SnA1TFczQTRVTUxZSC1GMUxtaXNjSDVHeEJtekZyQXVSMElnN2lsaG9xWVk3SnNSS1g2MzcxLW5iWTFyNG5jZDdYVXRQS3BSVzlWZ0JzTVAzR0VhX0lMYU9ueU9zY1JlMlNrc2Y1NmxRcndsVzNvaA?oc=5)

**Luca Lipani** The Sassuolo midfielder places great faith in coach Aquilani as his football mentor. With the right commitment, the National team will come naturally: a mindset befitting a true future star with eyes on 2030. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxQMHVOaVIyZEtUc294b3YzTUVuU2F4c3ZNcEgxeWFNUVJIZHNNWHB2MXdqOTdMbWlnRUdva2R2R1VMVW1sYmlvbkcyV0JpdDRvM2hkZ2ZPYTZQR1Q4UGxyMzVVVzVPS0xQTGN5Z2pXSUNHcFYwajNfTHJCQXhBQS0zVmFMaG16aktBMmdINzMxcTdMRjM0MHVRTkx6ZVZ5ZExXZ05KRHJR?oc=5)

**Giovanni Fabbian** Lazio is monitoring the midfielder on the market, though Gattuso appears oriented toward a different profile. Another confirmation of the major clubs' interest in Italy's young Next Gen talents. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxPd1hWaGkzaGtiTUZsYWVuMmdROHhGcmctekNaX1NvZ2FLREowaEZJeUk3bEJSTnd3MmpPT1BuVDd2TEEycElabk1teVNySlhZSjgxUzZIQVMxWTRqVjZqMk5hdjNQTW80Sm5RRnZhal9uNG1VcUJqLU1Janl1VGtVNkRoQXliN2M3ZkxiejY5NVlEaVNzZHVNaTNwWTdLRnRFbmc?oc=5)

**Mattia Marello** The midfielder continues to be monitored by major Serie A clubs in the torrid summer transfer window. A prospect on whom Italian top flight places concrete hopes for the coming years. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMic0FVX3lxTE5TWGpTV3NrYXF1bEtMZm5ZZThINmlCeW52M3htRlpKS2tST3p3dTc2alNsX2ZlM1hoVldvSWNjZ3Y5NHFtRDExcE8yMXNHTjYtakU2YU1MbS1LeUQxVjY1YWlubUp6Sm9RQWd6cmRUaUVYcVU?oc=5)
